scope: Source-only diagnosis of one actual physical test failure; existing xcresult extraction read, no runner or source mutation.

actual.failure: XCTUnwrap failed: expected non-nil value of type "WKWebView"

cause.kind: Native subtree ownership omitted by fixture
cause.detail: The adoption callback only assigns the coordinator. Adoption keeps the preparation Entry/host alive through the synchronous callback, then drops that Entry. Both coordinator.host and coordinator.webView are weak. With no receiving native host, the old host/viewport/WebKit subtree ends its lifetime and adopted.webView becomes nil synchronously.

sourceProof.fact: Entry strongly owns host; adoption explicitly requires synchronous configure/mount while the old Entry is retained.
Both host and webView references on coordinator are weak.
mount installs the exact existing WebKit into a receiving host and reclassifies the same lease to current priority.
UIKit host.install transfers the existing physical viewport; old host relinquishes that subtree.
The actual current-page adopter configures and mounts within that same synchronous callback.

pressureTrace: prepareIfIdle admits only optional idle capacity (DocumentShellPreparation38-64; SceneRenderResources494-498).
warning changes the pool optional generation and schedules pressure trim (SceneRenderResources529-552).
The trim selects an idle offer once, preserves the actual retiring slot through physical borrows, and calls retireUnused (SceneRenderResources515-525,575-578).

retireUnused clears the Entry before invalidation, removes its native surface; eventual Web lease release clears idle/retiring bookkeeping (DocumentShellPreparation81-86; SceneRenderResources1480-1491).
foreground clears only preparation retry state; prepareIfIdle still checks resources.allowsOptionalPreparation, so foreground cannot reopen pressure admission (DocumentShellPreparation38-41,89-90).
normal restores optional eligibility; a new shell reaches ready and adoption succeeds. No await lies between the failed fixture adoption and its nil unwrap.

minimalRepair.change: Retain a receiving DocumentWebHost through test cleanup; inside adoptForCurrentPage callback mount the same coordinator into that host with current-page/required role. Capture exact WebKit identity before adoption, then assert the receiving host owns that same WebKit after callback return and after critical pressure. Keep active count/non-invalidation/reclamation/foreground assertions and existing timeouts.
minimalRepair.cleanup: Invalidate the adopted coordinator and remove its receiving surface in defer; preserve preparation.stop().
minimalRepair.sufficientCheck: Rerun the same physical selector as part of Root's selected failure repair route.
